issues.issue: Can the application be converted into a class action before the validity of the regulations is finally decided?
issues.applicant_position: Conversion before judicial review ends makes s.18 meaningless; validity must be decided first.
issues.respondent_position: not stated; the Motions Judge held conversion before final disposition was permissible.
issues.result_quote: I find no problem in principle with conversion prior to a final disposition of the application for judicial review.

issues.issue: Can the class include people who paid fees under regulations not challenged in the leave application?
issues.applicant_position: Leave under s.72(1) covers only the regulation challenged, so the class must be limited to it.
issues.respondent_position: not stated; the Motions Judge certified a class covering all the impugned regulations.
issues.result_quote: In my opinion, the Motions Judge erred in defining the class to include persons who paid fees pursuant to the impugned regulations

issues.issue: Was a class action the preferable procedure for determining the validity of the regulations?
issues.applicant_position: A class action was not the preferable procedure; finding otherwise was an error.
issues.respondent_position: Class action is preferable: simpler restitution, no test case offered, one case management judge.
issues.result_quote: For these reasons I conclude that the Motions Judge did not err in exercising his discretion to decide that a class action was the preferable procedure.
